root_motivation: The annual recall-memories book is the artifact, but the operational bottleneck is the deterministic typesetting-input step: a script that walks the year's recall memories and produces a clean, ordered, frontmatter-rich Markdown bundle that a Typst template (Phase 1b) can consume. Without this composer the January ritual is a manual afternoon; with it, the ritual is `composer + render + send-to-printer`.
user_persona: jsy running it the first week of January for the prior calendar year, reading the resulting Markdown bundle to spot-check before handing to the Typst template. Audience: future jsy with a hardback book.

unfakeable_metric.name: acceptance_tests_passing
unfakeable_metric.harness_command: cargo test --tests 2>&1 | grep -E 'test result: ok' | wc -l

acceptance_criteria.description: `reliquary compose --year <YYYY> [--recall-root <dir>] [--out <file>]` reads memory index entries with subject==user and created_at within the calendar year, slurps each memory's Markdown body from disk, and emits a single bundle file. Default --recall-root: `$RECALL_HOME` or `~/.claude/recall`. Default --out: stdout.

The bundle format: each memory is a section separated by `\n---\n` lines. Each section starts with a YAML frontmatter block (id, kind, subject, recall_count, last_recalled_at, created_at), then a blank line, then the memory's Markdown body verbatim. The bundle starts with a top-level frontmatter block (year, generated_at, memory_count, recall_root) before the first separator.
Memories are ordered by created_at ascending. Two memories with identical timestamps tiebreak by id.
Memories whose frontmatter contains `private: true` are excluded from the bundle. The top-level frontmatter records `excluded_private_count: <N>` so the omission is auditable.
When the recall-root path does not exist or is not a directory: exit 2 with stderr containing the path and `recall root not found`.
A memory file whose YAML frontmatter is unparseable is skipped (not crashed) and a warning line is written to stderr: `WARN: skipping <path>: frontmatter parse error: <msg>`. The bundle continues.
`--subject <prefix>` overrides the default `user` subject filter (useful for `--subject self` to generate the agent's-own-memories companion volume).

`--include-recall-stats` adds two extra frontmatter fields per memory: `mattered: "low|medium|high"` derived from recall_count quantiles within the bundle, and `dormancy_days: <N>` = days between created_at and last_recalled_at (or 0).

scope: Read recall memory index (~/.claude/recall/index or compatible) — either parse SQLite via rusqlite or shell out to `recall list --format json --subject user --root <root>`
Per-entry: read the memory's Markdown body file at the index's `path` field
Compose a single Markdown bundle: top-level frontmatter, then per-memory frontmatter + body separated by `---`
Optional subject override, optional recall stats enrichment
non_goals: Typst, paged.js, PDF — bundle output only; rendering is Phase 1b
Cover design, glyph generation, font picking
Writing back to recall (e.g. adding `private: true`) — that's the user's act
Embedding-based clustering or auto-ordering by theme

five_whys_trace.q: Why a Markdown bundle as the composer's output rather than direct Typst source?
five_whys_trace.a: Because Markdown is the common ground recall already speaks (the memory bodies ARE Markdown). Typst-source generation belongs in the template stage which gets re-iterated for taste; the composer should output something stable that multiple Typst templates can consume.

five_whys_trace.q: Why shell out to (or duplicate) `recall list` rather than parse the SQLite index directly?
five_whys_trace.a: Because the recall schema is owned by recall and may evolve; a CLI contract is the stable interface. Parsing SQLite directly couples this binary to a schema version we don't own.

five_whys_trace.q: Why honour private:true at the composer rather than letting the user curate post-hoc?
five_whys_trace.a: Because the bundle becomes the typesetting input — if a private memory leaks past the composer, the typesetter has no signal to redact it. Privacy must be enforced where the data is first surfaced for export.
